message:
feat(standby): an activation owns its lease; ops, cancel, no lock across a wait (keepalive-r2 2 r3, N1 N2)

N2: ActivationArgs(args, keepAlive, &op) -- the handshake closure holds the runner's slot, so the lease outlives every
copy of the arguments after Release / ReleaseAll. Ops are process-wide; SessionOver(op) / Abandon(op, handle) of
another op do nothing and are refused while the handshake runs; a stale handshake (abandoned, superseded) refuses to
start. Release while handed off cancels the handshake in flight (it returns false). The pump and the handshake never
read at once (ActivationArgs / ObserveFrom wait out the pump's 20 ms wait), and nothing holds a lock across a wait --
the pump no longer holds the slot lock, so a UI call never starves behind it. StatusOf is one coherent snapshot; the
event notes are bounded (32).

N1: the lease accepts a HelloAck only through udp_hello_ack_acceptable + its declared size; an invalid one sets no
state and no features.

standby_lease_test (fake host on loopback): 43/43, 15 repeats clean; 10 mutants all FAIL.
host_standby_admission_e2e --product-client --real-directory --old-host: see the report.
